description:
Give an agent's mascot a new look made on the server, from a website_url, a description, or both; neither for a random one. The agent's prompt is not changed. Takes up to a minute; this tool waits for it and returns the agent (mascot.status ready, or failed with mascot.error and the old look). Charged for the model tokens it spends. Same limits as generate_agent. Also needs knowledge_bases:write when a knowledge base is made or rewritten.

Requires scope `agents:write`.

description.description: The brand, its tone, a colour.

refresh_knowledge.description: With website_url: rewrite the agent's knowledge base from the website. Changes what it says on phone calls too; ask first. Without it the website only sets the look, and gives the agent a knowledge base if it has none.

website_url.description: The business's website. Read once, not stored.

name: generate_agent_mascot
title: Generate a new mascot look
